still.title: Still wallpapers
still.description: Set any still wallpaper from Codelume as your macOS desktop wallpaper.

video.title: Video wallpapers
video.description: Keep a video playing on your desktop. You can also convert it to a native macOS wallpaper that slows to a still image when you return from the screen saver. Native mode requires the website edition and macOS 26 or later.

scene.title: Scene wallpapers
scene.description: Built with SpriteKit, scene wallpapers support multiple layers, shaders, and animations. Scene elements can respond to mouse movement and clicks.

depth.title: Depth wallpapers
depth.description: Separate foreground and background layers give the image a sense of depth.

web.title: Web wallpapers
web.description: Show web content, animations, and live information on your desktop.

native.title: Native macOS wallpapers
points: Supports still wallpapers and animated screen saver transitions.
Motion slows to a still image when you return to the desktop.
native.availability: Available only in the website edition on macOS 26 or later. The App Store edition’s sandbox prevents this feature.

codelume.title: Codelume wallpapers
points: Supports still, video, scene, depth, and web wallpapers.
Supports screen saver integration. Animated wallpapers keep playing on the desktop.
